svg.title: Тяга гантелей грудью на наклонной скамье — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Chest-supported dumbbell row lying face down on a clearly inclined adjustable exercise bench, about 35 degrees. Three-quarter side view, upper chest stays firmly against long sloping backrest, head above the top edge, feet braced on floor behind. Two independent dumbbells, one in each hand. Left arms hang vertically below shoulders with dumbbells low. Right elbows draw up behind ribs, dumbbells pulled close to sides of lower chest. Same visible chest contact, bench incline and foot placement in both poses. No cable or barbell. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
